{"notes": "Visit 2 (4:45). Ratings still provisional. I can't tell who placed which domino, so I'm rating only what I saw and heard. Table: top line, tail tip and the upper back edge down to ~(26.3, 11) are dark, so connected. The bottom line is finished out to the lower tip (~27.5, 14.8) and connected. Remaining: the back edge still has ~4 units to go through the notch to the bottom tip, and the stub near (18, 13) is still visible. About 5 minutes left, which looks workable.

Leo: Instructions stayed stable this visit, which fixes my visit-1 concern. He's laying the back edge himself, gave a clear status at 4:30 and a clear handoff to Priya (check the bottom tip joint). He is the critical path now: the back edge is the only unfinished piece. Leadership and collaboration trending up. Watch his pace.

Priya: Strongest this visit. Her bottom-line report matches the picture. She flagged the stray bit to Tom, told Leo she'd stay off his area, and sequenced her tip-joint check after his work. She also told me privately the chain falls from the start, and the image supports that. Excellent communication and collaboration, and she acts as de facto quality checker. I'm not yet seeing leadership beyond that.

Tom: Finished the bottom line, the longest stretch, so his execution and impact are solid. He answered Priya at 4:00 and owned the stub. But he said it was gone, and the stub still looks present, and Priya and Leo are still discussing it. It's minor and possibly harmless, but ask him about it. He is still quiet, and I haven't seen him help with the back edge.

Maya: Not observed this visit. No new evidence, so I'm keeping my visit-1 view (clear communicator, completed the top line). Check what she's doing now."}
